meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会帮你完成NanoClaw从旧版(v1)到新版(v2)的迁移收尾：确认迁移进度、设置你的管理员身份、迁移聊天记忆、检查容器配置，并协助处理旧版的自定义代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 migration”等触发词，或刚跑完迁移脚本需要继续收尾时，它会启动。

say.text: 帮我完成v1到v2的迁移收尾
say.note: Claude会先检查迁移脚本是否已运行

say.text: 迁移脚本跑完了，接下来怎么办？
把我设为这个机器人的管理员
say.note: 它会查询用户列表并授予owner角色

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2: checks migration progress, sets you as owner, migrates chat memory, checks container configs, and helps handle custom v1 code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration", or right after the migration script finishes and needs follow-up.

say_en.text: Help me finish the v1 to v2 migration.
say_en.note: Claude first checks if the migration script ran.

say_en.text: The migration script is done, what's next?
Make me the admin of this bot.
say_en.note: It queries users and grants the owner role.
